### EQC001 — Spin-1 and Cartesian-basis conventions

*Fixes the local basis in which every bond conserved quantity is diagonal.*

$$
|x>=(|+1>-|-1>)/sqrt(2), |y>=(|+1>+|-1>)/sqrt(2), |z>=|0>; R_x=diag(+1,-1,-1), R_y=diag(-1,+1,-1)
$$

### EQC002 — Alternating Kitaev-AKLT Hamiltonian and bond sectors

*Defines the physical Hamiltonian and the exact commuting blocks used for diagonalization.*

$$
H(theta)=sum_even[K Sx_j Sx_j+1+Q(Sx_j Sx_j+1)^2]+sum_odd[K Sy_j Sy_j+1+Q(Sy_j Sy_j+1)^2], K=cos(theta), Q=sin(theta); W_even=Ry_j Ry_j+1, W_odd=Rx_j Rx_j+1
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC001` · source: tex_label: eq.H; tex_label: eq.Ws

Numerical form:

```
Filter Cartesian product configurations by r_axis(a_j) r_axis(a_j+1)=w_j, then assemble H only inside that exact block.
```

Code: `src/kitaev_aklt.py:sector_basis`, `src/kitaev_aklt.py:sector_hamiltonian`


### EQC003 — Positive-projector identity at theta=pi/4

*Makes the exactly solvable point frustration free and fixes its zero-energy target.*

$$
P_(S_i^a+S_j^a=+/-2)=1/2[A_a+A_a^2], A_a=S_i^a S_j^a; H_(pi/4)=sqrt(2) sum_b P_b
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC001`, `EQC002` · source: tex_label: eq.Hproject; tex_contains: Projection onto maximal moments along the bond direction

Numerical form:

```
Each two-site bond matrix is compared against sqrt(2) times an idempotent rank-two projector.
```

### EQC004 — Fractionalized bond states are frustration free

*Explains why every one of the 2^N bond choices is annihilated by all projectors after on-site spin-1 projection.*

$$
S_i^a+S_j^a=sigma_i,L^a+(sigma_i,R^a+sigma_j,L^a)+sigma_j,R^a, with the central pair in |s> or |t_a> and therefore central total a-spin zero
$$


$$
